description: This file is a C++ source file for the DisplaySettings plugin in the RDK environment, handling display, audio, HDMI, and system configurations via IARM bus events, device interfaces, and JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: DisplaySettings
classes.description: Main plugin class handling display, audio, HDMI events, and configuration methods.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A helper class used for dispatching asynchronous tasks.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up RPC handlers, and registers IARM events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters events, and shuts down threads.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Sets up the IARM bus event handlers for display events.

methods.name: DisplResolutionHandler
methods.description: Handles resolution change events.

methods.name: resolutionPreChange
methods.description: Handles pre-resolution change logic.

methods.name: resolutionChanged
methods.description: Handles post-resolution change logic.

methods.name: connectedVideoDisplaysUpdated
methods.description: Updates cache and notifies changes for connected video displays.

methods.name: connectedAudioPortUpdated
methods.description: Updates cache and notifies changes for connected audio ports.

methods.name: notifyAudioFormatChange
methods.description: Handles notification of audio format change.

methods.name: notifyVideoFormatChange
methods.description: Handles notification of video format change.

methods.name: getDRCMode
methods.description: Gets the DRC (Dynamic Range Control) mode for a specified audio port.

methods.name: getSurroundVirtualizer
methods.description: Retrieves the surround virtualizer settings for a specified audio port.

methods.name: getSurroundVirtualizer2
methods.description: Retrieves the surround virtualizer mode and boost (version 2) for a specified audio port.

methods.name: getMISteering
methods.description: Retrieves whether MI Steer (Multi-Input Steering) is enabled on a specified audio port.

methods.name: setVolumeLeveller
methods.description: Sets the volume leveller level and mode for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setVolumeLeveller2
methods.description: Sets the volume leveller mode and level (version 2) for a specified audio port.

methods.name: enableSurroundDecoder
methods.description: Enables or disables the surround decoder.

methods.name: setBassEnhancer
methods.description: Sets the bass enhancer boost level for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setSurroundVirtualizer
methods.description: Configures the surround virtualizer's boost and mode.

methods.name: setSurroundVirtualizer2
methods.description: Configures surround virtualizer mode and boost (version 2).

methods.name: setMISteering
methods.description: Enables or disables MI Steer on a specified audio port.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets the gain level for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setMuted
methods.description: Sets the muted state for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setVolumeLevel
methods.description: Sets the absolute volume level for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setDRCMode
methods.description: Sets the Dynamic Range Control mode for a specified audio port.

methods.name: setMS12AudioCompression
methods.description: Sets the MS12 audio compression level for a specified port.

methods.name: getMS12AudioCompression
methods.description: Retrieves the MS12 audio compression setting for a specified port.

methods.name: setDolbyVolumeMode
methods.description: Sets Dolby Volume Mode for a specified port.

methods.name: getDolbyVolumeMode
methods.description: Retrieves the Dolby Volume Mode for a specified port.

methods.name: setDialogEnhancement
methods.description: Sets the dialog enhancement level.

methods.name: getDialogEnhancement
methods.description: Retrieves the dialog enhancement setting.

methods.name: setIntelligentEqualizerMode
methods.description: Sets the intelligent equalizer mode.

methods.name: getIntelligentEqualizerMode
methods.description: Retrieves the intelligent equalizer mode.

methods.name: setGraphicEqualizerMode
methods.description: Sets the graphic equalizer mode.

methods.name: getGraphicEqualizerMode
methods.description: Retrieves the graphic equalizer mode.

methods.name: setMS12AudioProfile
methods.description: Sets the MS12 audio profile.

methods.name: getMS12AudioProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the current MS12 audio profile.

methods.name: getSupportedMS12AudioProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported MS12 audio profiles.

methods.name: setAssociatedAudioMixing
methods.description: Enables or disables associated audio mixing.

methods.name: getAssociatedAudioMixing
methods.description: Retrieves whether associated audio mixing is enabled.

methods.name: setFaderControl
methods.description: Sets the fader (mixer) balance.

methods.name: getFaderControl
methods.description: Retrieves the current fader (mixer) balance.

methods.name: setPrimaryLanguage
methods.description: Sets the primary audio language.

methods.name: getPrimaryLanguage
methods.description: Gets the primary audio language.

methods.name: setSecondaryLanguage
methods.description: Sets the secondary audio language.

methods.name: getSecondaryLanguage
methods.description: Gets the secondary audio language.

methods.name: getAudioDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the audio delay (latency).

methods.name: setAudioDelay
methods.description: Sets the audio delay (latency).

methods.name: getSinkAtmosCapability
methods.description: Retrieves the sink device's Atmos capability.

methods.name: setAudioAtmosOutputMode
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos audio output mode.

methods.name: setForceHDRMode
methods.description: Overrides the HDR mode with a specified video format.

methods.name: getPreferredColorDepth
methods.description: Gets the preferred color depth of a video port.

methods.name: setPreferredColorDepth
methods.description: Sets the preferred color depth of a video port.

methods.name: getColorDepthCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the supported color depths for a port.

methods.name: getSupportedMS12Config
methods.description: Retrieves the MS12 configuration supported by the platform.
